target_definition.event: future stop-hunt sweep with rejection through prior high/low liquidity pool
target_definition.ignore_zone: insufficient past pool bars, missing full future horizon, or invalid prices
target_definition.negative_condition: full horizon exists and no positive sweep occurs
target_definition.no_lookahead_rule: features/pools use bars <= t; labels use bars t+1..t+horizon after features are fixed
target_definition.positive_condition: future high sweeps prior high pool and closes back below it, or future low sweeps prior low pool and closes back above it
target_definition.regime_conditioning: existing regime label used for model routing only; not used to create labels
